title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A sweet and indulgent Algerian dish featuring ancho chillies, this low-fat-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the ancho chillies, cumin, cinnamon, and honey, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 25-30 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot over couscous or rice.
